cards.name: Soul Salvage
cards.oracle_text: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Necrobite
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gains deathtouch until end of turn. Regenerate it. (The next time that creature would be destroyed this turn, instead tap it, remove it from combat, and heal all damage on it.)

cards.name: Renegade's Getaway
cards.oracle_text: Target permanent gains indestructible until end of turn. Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token. (Effects that say "destroy" don't destroy a permanent with indestructible, and if it's a creature, it can't be destroyed by damage.)

cards.name: Spirit of Malevolence
cards.oracle_text: When this creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Vicious Offering
cards.oracle_text:
Kicker—Sacrifice a creature. (You may sacrifice a creature in addition to any other costs as you cast this spell.)
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn instead.

cards.name: Foot Mystic
cards.oracle_text:
Lifelink
Disappear — When this creature enters, if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn, create a 1/1 black Ninja creature token.

cards.name: Kami of Terrible Secrets
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, if you control an artifact and an enchantment, you draw a card and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Scourge of the Undercity
cards.oracle_text:
Lifelink (Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.)
When this creature enters, another target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.

cards.oracle_text:
